video_title: The Warriors Can't Afford LeBron — Bobby Marks

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks on the math behind a potential LeBron James Warriors deal
quotes.excerpt: I never rule anything out in this world, but you just look at the math of it.
quotes.quote: I never rule anything out in this world, but you just look at the math of it. They are 27 million below the first apron. They are going to bring back Draymond Green. You don't leave 27 on the table to explore free agency. Even if he came back at 20 million, you are 7 million, and anything you use more than 6.1 of that non-tax mid-level, you get hard-capped. So when you look at it from that perspective, unless LeBron wants to come on the minimum, no, you don't have 15 million to offer.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks on Draymond Green's decision to opt out of his contract
quotes.excerpt: I think it's probably, hey, opt out of your contract, at the very least you'll have 27.7 waiting.
quotes.quote: I think it's probably, hey, opt out of your contract, at the very least you'll have 27.7 waiting for you if nothing works out. I think it just gives them, it would have given them, and it might still, the flexibility to go out and maneuver in free agency now. I wouldn't be surprised if he signed a one-year 27.7 million dollar contract. I think it's hard for me to think that they are going to want to sign him to a multi-year deal. Your books are pretty clean. I know Porzingis comes on next for has another year and stuff, but with Butler and him expiring, you could basically remake your roster next off-season here.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks on the Warriors' reluctance to trade for Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: I think what Mike and the group don't want to do is trade for Anthony Davis.
quotes.quote: I think what Mike and the group don't want to do is trade for Anthony Davis and give up a ton and then have, don't have LeBron coming. So like, that would be probably the worst-case scenario to think, right? Because it's going to, because here's the thing, and I said this on TV today, it's like, everybody's making it, we're talking about this and it's great. And the Wizards are over here saying like, what about us? You know, like, what is the incentive for the Wizards to trade Anthony Davis right now? And if I were them, and no offense to the Warriors, I would squeeze them out of everything possible because there is no incentive to do a deal with Golden State unless I'm getting three picks and a swap.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks on Austin Reaves' contract and its impact on the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: The number moves significantly from the day before, which was roughly five for 150.
quotes.quote: The number moves significantly from the day before, which was roughly five for 150. And it all of a sudden, and I think what happened with the Lakers, I think they got nervous that there was going to be teams out there lining their books to sign Austin Reaves, and they basically gave him a four-year max contract. The number doesn't have an impact on LeBron at all, because how the cap works, it's, it's basically they've got 53 million dollars no matter what, because Austin's number doesn't count right now until he signs it, and they're using a lower cap hold for that. So it doesn't, it has an impact, you know, certainly next year and everything like that, but for right now, I mean, with your, the Lakers are operating at whatever 50, 52, 53 million dollars in room.

You know, I mean, maybe it's, maybe you can find a team that there's only Brooklyn and, Brooklyn and Chicago has room. Would a team take a flyer on him on him and maybe give him a one-year deal and everything like that? But yeah, it's just, it's the, you know, guys aren't, guys aren't going for him as much as they probably thought they they would.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Marks on Brandon Podziemski's potential contract extension
quotes.excerpt: Guys who are not max extensions usually get played out in October.
quotes.quote: I always say, guys who are not max extensions usually get played out in October. I wouldn't be surprised if there's there's something done within the next months or two. You know, those are those are require, unless they unless there's a there's something that makes sense here. It's hard to comp, you know, guys like him. I mean, we've seen we've seen guys go in the late teens, early 20s, the caps are all rising, so the numbers are a little bit different than what they were, you know, a couple years ago.
